_doc: Sound of the sim town (scripts/audio/sonido.gd, docs/sonido.md). Files by id: assets/audio/<section>/<id>.ogg or its variants <id>_01.ogg, <id>_02.ogg... (one at random each time). A missing file is silence (and a line in the debug log). Levels in dB; hours in game hours (0-24, fractions allowed); radii in metres on the ground from the point the camera looks at.

buses._doc: Created at run time under Master. reverb: wet/room of the Efectos and Voces reverb when a house is open (0 outside). duck_db: music down while a house is open. Music is also compressed by the voices (sidechain).

zoom._doc: near: up to this camera size the point sounds are heard in their place; far: from this size on the town is one wide ambient (point sounds off, place layers by the whole town's share). radius_near / radius_far: hearing radius of the point sounds at near and at far-1 zoom (linear between). listener_h: listener height over the ground point.

lugares._doc: Places under the camera: tiles of the map that make each place (map legend in pueblo.gd) and the radius (m) where its layer fades out. Building types make a place around their footprint. town_share: its weight in the far view.

ambiente._doc: Ambient layers (looped, on the Ambiente bus). Weight = horas (curve by hour, [hour, weight] points) x estacion x clima x lugar x zoom. lugar: the place layer weight (1 if absent); lugar_min: weight left away from it. clima: weight by weather state (missing = 1); lluvia_x / viento_x: weight times the rain intensity / wind. lejos: factor in the far view; cerca: factor in the near view. volume_db: level at weight 1.

clima._doc: The weather comes from the node in group 'clima' (estado, intensidad 0..1, viento 0..1, signal relampago(pos)). Without it: despejado, or --so_clima=<estado>[:<intensidad>[:<viento>]] for tests (the clima node itself takes --tiempo=). light / heavy: rain intensity curve of each rain layer. muffle_hz: low-pass of the ambient bus by state (snow and fog dull the town). thunder: speed of sound (m/s, real seconds), the near/far file split (m) and the level by distance.

musica._doc: The first rule that matches plays. si: fase (dawn/day/dusk/night of the trace), horas [from, to), estacion, clima (list), lugar (place weight > 0.5 under the camera, near views only), suceso (the kind of the festival standing, data sucesos: from the node of scripts/fiestas_pueblo.gd in group 'suceso', or --suceso=<kind or festival id>). fade: crossfade s; hold: minimum seconds before changing again (a rule with urgent: true changes at once). volume_db per track. gap: seconds of silence between two loops of the same track (0: seamless).

golpes._doc: Sounds on the frames of an animation (anim name without 'own/'). t: times in the cycle (s); empty = the 'sharp' keys of data/chars/anims.json. id: sound; volume_db; max: how many of that sound at once; reach: m in front of the body where it sounds (the anvil, the bench).

pasos._doc: Footsteps of who walks near the camera (zoom <= zoom.steps_zoom). Contact times as fractions of the clip; the ground under the foot picks the sound: tiles of piedra = stone (plaza, roads), the rest earth. max: steps at once; radius: m.

animales._doc: Calls of the animals of PuebloVivo near the camera: id of the beast -> sound, chance per real second, hours when they call, level.

campanas._doc: The church bells: at each hour in horas, as many strokes as the hour (1-12), spaced every s real seconds; a peal before mass (the first 'mass' state of each day in the trace, misa_antes game minutes earlier). Heard everywhere: near the church positional, far on the Lejos bus.

mercado._doc: Vendors and haggling at the stalls while there are people shopping near them (doing shopping/market); the crier at the notice board at the hours listed. every: [min, max] real seconds between two calls.

fuentes._doc: Fixed looped sources heard in their place (zoom <= zoom.far). The nearest 'players' get a player; the rest wait. fuente: the plaza fountain; rio: points along the river every 'step' m; fragua: the forges while somebody works there (bellows one-shots now and then); hogar: houses with somebody awake inside after dark or at dawn; carro: the cart of the road.

interior._doc: With a house open: its ambient layer by building type (weight 1 near it) and the reverb of the buses.

sucesos._doc: Festival or event of the town (scripts/fiestas_pueblo.gd, its def id) -> the kind the music rules and the ambient layers (suceso) read. Not listed: no kind (the town sounds as any day).

fiestas._doc: Sounds of the festivals in their place, read from scripts/fiestas_pueblo.gd. hoguera: each lit fire of a piece whose name begins with 'piezas' (its flames visible; not the torches) is a looped source on the players of fuentes. comparsa: the drum and dulzaina follow the giants and big-heads (walkers of the festivals in defs). campanas_vuelo: the peal over and over (every [min, max] real s) while a procession walks (from 'antes' game minutes before its start to its end) and around the acts listed (from antes to minutos after). torneo: a lance and the cheers at the lists every [min, max] s from the act desde to the act hasta.

limites._doc: Voices at once for the whole town and the one-shot pool.
